snippet.title: This game is meant for soldiers who follow orders.
snippet.description:
What Happened to Squad 7 is a thriller mystery drama visual novel where you decide the fate of the cast, and yourself as your Squad is assigned to eliminate an 'alien' threat on the Southern border of the United States. Trust your gut, follow orders, and assure you will be forevermore. Coming to Steam Next Fest - June Edition, June 15th!

STEAM (WISHLIST!):
